-ITO Chowk
-Delhi Gate
-Guru Nanak Chowk
-Shanti Van Chowk
-Rajghat DTC Depot
-IP Flyover

-BSZ Marg (ITO to Delhi Gate)
-Shanti Van Chowk to IP Flyover
-Asaf Ali Road (Delhi Gate to N.S. Marg)
-Shanti Van Chowk to Nishad Raj Marg
-Guru Nanak Chowk to Ranjeet Singh Flyover

📍COMMUTERS ARE ADVISED TO:
-Use public transport to reduce congestion
-Park only in designated parking areas
-Plan travel in advance during the specified hours

data.raw_text:
LOOK: The MMDA, led by General Manager Nicolas Torre III and organizers of “EDSA 40: Tuloy ang Laban sa Korapsyon at Kahirapan,” along with representatives from national and local agencies, conducted a walk-through inspection at the People Power Monument at White Plains corner Edsa in Quezon City on February 20. 

They discussed crowd management, traffic flow, security measures, and other preparations for the 40th anniversary of the People Power Revolution on February 25. [1/2] | via Niño Jesus Orbeta, Philippine Daily Inquirer
